title: Brown meets Teller and LeMay; driven by Sarbacher
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Brown meets Teller and LeMay; driven by Sarbacher, about 1950s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Townsend Brown's daughter Linda even recalls that he was often taken home in a black Cadillac driven by a man that she would eventually come to know as Robert Sarbacher.

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, tells how in the 1950s an inventor named Townsend Brown, who worked on ideas about controlling gravity, met with the physicist Edward Teller and the Air Force general Curtis LeMay. Drawing on a biography called The Man Who Mastered Gravity by Paul Schatzkin, Michels says Brown's daughter Linda remembers her father often being driven home in a black Cadillac by a man she later learned was Robert Sarbacher. Michels tells it because, if true, it would put Brown at the centre of secret work tied to the UFO question.
